tokens.name: color-hatun-100
tokens.usage: Hatun (Quechua: great) gold scale. Step 100. Reach for the role tokens first.

tokens.name: color-hatun-200
tokens.usage: Hover for gold fills on dark (bridge gold-bright); tagline tint in social cards.

tokens.name: color-hatun-300
tokens.usage: THE accent on dark. Primary buttons, eyebrows, active nav, card titles. 10:1 on color-a11oy-bg.

tokens.name: color-hatun-400
tokens.usage: Dimmed gold (color-a11oy-gold-dim): secondary gold marks on dark.

tokens.name: color-hatun-500
tokens.usage: Same value as color-warning.

tokens.name: color-hatun-600
tokens.usage: Hatun (Quechua: great) gold scale. Step 600. Reach for the role tokens first.

tokens.name: color-hatun-700
tokens.usage: Gold as text and fill on light grounds (6.1:1 on white).

tokens.name: color-hatun-800
tokens.usage: Caution text on light grounds (color-ink-caution); gold-fill hover on light.

tokens.name: color-hatun-900
tokens.usage: Hatun (Quechua: great) gold scale. Step 900. Reach for the role tokens first.

tokens.name: color-gray-50
tokens.usage: Neutral scale, biased toward the navy ground. Light-theme page ground; primary text on dark (as color-a11oy-text).

tokens.name: color-gray-100
tokens.usage: Neutral scale, biased toward the navy ground. Light-theme recessed panels (sidebar, wells).

tokens.name: color-gray-200
tokens.usage: Neutral scale, biased toward the navy ground. Secondary text on dark (color-a11oy-text-sub); hairline borders on light.

tokens.name: color-gray-300
tokens.usage: Neutral scale, biased toward the navy ground. Supporting copy in social cards.

tokens.name: color-gray-400
tokens.usage: Neutral scale, biased toward the navy ground. Ghost text on dark (5.1:1 on bg); control borders in both themes (3:1 or better).

tokens.name: color-gray-500
tokens.usage: Neutral scale, biased toward the navy ground. Ghost text on light (6.5:1 on white). On dark it is decorative only (2.9:1 on bg).

tokens.name: color-gray-600
tokens.usage: Neutral scale, biased toward the navy ground. Secondary text on light; the canonical border on dark.

tokens.name: color-gray-700
tokens.usage: Neutral scale, biased toward the navy ground. Overlay and hover fill on dark.

tokens.name: color-gray-800
tokens.usage: Neutral scale, biased toward the navy ground. Raised surface on dark (cards).

tokens.name: color-gray-900
tokens.usage: Neutral scale, biased toward the navy ground. Primary text on light; deep panels on dark.

tokens.name: color-gray-950
tokens.usage: Neutral scale, biased toward the navy ground. The ground. Navy-black page background on dark.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Success fills, dots, bars and large numbers. Text 5.5:1 on the dark ground; on light only as a mark or 24px+ (3.5:1 on white).

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Warning fills and marks on dark (6.6:1 on bg). On light use color-ink-caution (this is 2.9:1 on white).

tokens.name: color-error
tokens.usage: Error fills, destructive buttons (with color-gray-50 text, 5.0:1), dots and heat. Not text on dark (3.5:1): use color-ink-danger.

tokens.name: color-info
tokens.usage: Info marks and the a11oy blue. As text it is just under AA on dark (4.4:1), so pair it with a word in color-a11oy-text-sub.

tokens.name: color-a11oy-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Every text token is checked against it.

tokens.name: color-a11oy-deep
tokens.usage: Recessed panels: sidebar, toolbars, drawers, output wells.

tokens.name: color-a11oy-surface
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, stats, dialogs.

tokens.name: color-a11oy-overlay
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fills, secondary buttons, skeleton base.

tokens.name: color-a11oy-border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between regions. Decorative (2.0:1 on the dark ground), so never the only edge of a control: use color-control-border.

tokens.name: color-a11oy-text
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on bg, deep, surface and overlay (11.9:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: color-a11oy-text-sub
tokens.usage: Paragraphs, blurbs, secondary labels, badge words. 5.9:1 or better on every ground in both themes.

tokens.name: color-a11oy-text-ghost
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions, idle nav icons, placeholders. Dark: 5.1:1 on bg, 4.3:1 on surface (14px+ there), 3.4:1 on overlay (avoid).

tokens.name: color-a11oy-navy
tokens.usage: Alias kept for flagships that reference it; same as color-a11oy-bg.

tokens.name: color-a11oy-blue
tokens.usage: Alias kept for flagships that reference it; same as color-info.

tokens.name: color-a11oy-gold
tokens.usage: The accent as a role: primary fills, eyebrows, active states, card titles. 10:1 on the dark ground; 6.1:1 on white.

tokens.name: color-a11oy-gold-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary gold marks and hover borders. The light value is 4.1:1 on white: marks and 24px+ text only.

tokens.name: color-a11oy-gold-soft
tokens.usage: Gold wash behind gold text or icons (hatun-400 at 14%). The source writes it with color-mix(); this is the same color.

tokens.name: color-a11oy-success
tokens.usage: Alias kept for flagships that reference it; same as color-success.

tokens.name: color-a11oy-border-subtle
tokens.usage: Softer hairline (border at 55%): card and panel edges, sidebar dividers.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Bridge name from the landing CSS (was #0a0a0a). New code: color-a11oy-bg.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Bridge name from the landing CSS (was #0c0c0c). New code: color-a11oy-deep.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Bridge name from the landing CSS (was #c9b787). New code: color-a11oy-gold.

tokens.name: gold-bright
tokens.usage: Hover for gold fills: primary button and CTA pill. Dark hatun-200, light hatun-800.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Bridge name from the landing CSS (was #f5f5f5). New code: color-a11oy-text.

tokens.name: paragraph
tokens.usage: Bridge name from the landing CSS (was #9a9a9a). New code: color-a11oy-text-sub.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Bridge name (was #888888); same role as color-a11oy-text-ghost.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Bridge name (was #555555). Decorative only: rails, idle dots. Never text (2.9:1 on the dark ground).

tokens.name: gold-line
tokens.usage: Gold hairline (hatun-300 at 15%): eyebrow pill, output panel, outline button borders.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Faint gold wash (hatun-300 at 4%): eyebrow pill fill.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: Bridge name (was #5a8a6e): the live dot.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: House teal (was #5fb3a3): proof and signal accents. As text 16px+ only on dark.

tokens.name: teal-soft
tokens.usage: Teal wash (yuyay-500 at 10%) behind teal marks.

tokens.name: teal-line
tokens.usage: Teal hairline (yuyay-500 at 32%).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Bridge hairline (border at 55%); same color as color-a11oy-border-subtle.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Bridge neutral hairline; same as color-a11oy-border.

tokens.name: color-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, solid, border-focus wide, 2px offset. 4.5:1 or better on bg, deep and surface in both themes; 3:1 or better on overlay.

tokens.name: color-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a color-a11oy-gold fill (10:1 dark, 5.7:1 light).

tokens.name: color-control-border
tokens.usage: The edge of inputs and selects: 3:1 or better on bg, deep and surface in both themes, so a control reads without its fill.

tokens.name: color-ink-danger
tokens.usage: Danger as text or small marks: CRITICAL chips, error copy. 6.4:1 dark, 7.2:1 light.

tokens.name: color-ink-caution
tokens.usage: Caution as text or small marks: HIGH chips, warn tones. 6.6:1 dark, 9:1 light.

tokens.name: color-ink-signal
tokens.usage: Teal as text: proof links, verified hashes, SIGNAL labels. 9.2:1 dark, 8.1:1 light.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Landing hero headline. The source sets clamp(2.6rem, 6vw, 5.2rem); this is its ceiling. One per page.

styles.name: display-section
styles.usage: Landing section headings. The source sets clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem).

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Console page title (FabricHeader). The light weight is the house look.

styles.name: body-lead
styles.sample: One substrate, hash-chained, deny by default.
styles.usage: Hero support copy and lead paragraphs, at most 36rem wide, in color-a11oy-text-sub.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default body and blurbs in the console.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Sidebar links and the header brand name.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Badges; compact buttons use it at weight 500.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Stat sub-lines and footnotes, in color-a11oy-text-ghost.

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: Numbers in FabricStat. Always tabular-nums; the light weight is deliberate.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: UPPERCASE kicker above a page title, in color-a11oy-gold.

styles.name: label-mono
styles.usage: UPPERCASE labels on stats, FabricCard titles, drawer kickers.

styles.name: nav-section
styles.usage: UPPERCASE sidebar section labels, in color-a11oy-text-ghost.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Receipts, hashes, API paths and output panels.

tokens.name: space-12

tokens.name: space-16

tokens.name: space-20

tokens.name: space-24

tokens.name: radius-md

tokens.name: radius-lg

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Social banners and Space hero frames.

tokens.name: radius-full

tokens.name: shadow-md

tokens.name: shadow-lg

tokens.name: shadow-xl
tokens.usage: Modals.

tokens.name: shadow-focus

tokens.name: border-thick
